**DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA INSURANCE REGULATORY AND** Ref No. IRDA/SUR(#t'fti' # # # a request from IIISLA with regard to granting of chartered status to them. There are various issues that need to be examined before considering the request of IIISLA for chartered status. The issues raised, deserve to be discussed and debated by a select group of insurers, surveyors and representatives from the regulator and government. Therefore, the Shri.R.Suresh, Principal Officer, Spl. Projects Cholamandalam MS Gen.Ins.Co.Ltd, Member Shri. P.J.Joseph, Member (NL), IRDAI - Chairperson, Shri. Suresh Mathur, ED (Surveyors), IRDAI, Member, Shri. Sudeep Dutta, Chief Manager, Oriental Insurance, Member recommendations after detailed examination of various issues related Smt.
